verdict.rationale: The only evidence of region-preserving local edits is mask-based re-editing for Image 3.0 Omni, a still-image feature that does not carry over to video. The other items are too general to credit: video can be used as an input, a 'video input' generation tier is priced, and the site mentions refining and editing videos in post-production. None of these documents replacing or restyling an element inside an existing video while the rest of the frame stays intact.
